summary: Frontend E2E validation of ROYAL11's new Daily Bonus + Promo apply + Refer 200 UI. All 4 review-request items PASS end-to-end. Registered a brand new player via signup+OTP (OTP fetched from backend OTP_DEBUG log), opened Rewards modal on /wallet, exercised promo happy/duplicate/invalid, joined a practice Points Rummy table, claimed daily bonus, verified countdown + reload persistence, verified in-table rewards button + emoji badge, and confirmed /wallet, lobby, and rummy table load without errors.

critical_code_review_comments: ReferAndEarn heading correctly renders the referrer amount only after /api/referrals/me responds — E2E tests must wait for data to load before asserting on the heading (heading temporarily shows 'Refer & Earn' without amount for ~1s). Consider preloading config or showing a skeleton to prevent copy flicker.

DailyBonusWidget uses server_time to compute skew and derives the countdown from Date.now() - skew — good server-authoritative pattern, correctly resisted the reload-based cheat (state was refetched server-side).

RummyTable auto-opens the Round Result / LowChipsPopup modals which can visually overlap the DailyBonusWidget bottom-left; force clicks still work but a real user tapping through modals is fine because the widget is z-index 40 vs modals at higher z. Non-blocking.
Practice-mode Rummy table auto-plays a bot round almost immediately on entry (round already SETTLED with pot 80) — good for smoke tests but the Scoreboard modal may pop before the tester interacts.
test_credentials: Fresh accounts registered via UI signup + OTP: qa_1786803869_3685@royal11.com / Test1234! (used for Rummy + Daily Bonus + Promo). Existing player1@royal11.com / ChangeMe123! was used only for an isolated wallet-modal spot-check.
seed_data_creation: Two throwaway QA players registered via UI signup: qa_1786803695_1222@royal11.com and qa_1786803869_3685@royal11.com (both verified via OTP). Both claimed +100 WELCOME100 (once each) and +50 daily bonus (once each).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Daily Bonus + Promo + Refer 200 UI flows are green. Two gotchas for future runs: (1) After signup redirect the /wallet page can briefly be covered by the 'Welcome +1000 bonus coins' toast — press Escape or wait 3s before clicking wallet-refer-btn. (2) ReferAndEarn heading interpolates the amount only after /api/referrals/me loads, so poll `page.text_content('refer-heading')` for '200' rather than asserting on the first read. (3) On Points Rummy practice tables a bot auto-starts a round and the Scoreboard modal can overlap the bottom-left DailyBonusWidget — dismiss it via the Continue button before claiming, or use force=True clicks. OTP debug logs are still emitted by app.otp_service to /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log with format 'OTP_DEBUG <email> -> <code>'.
rca of the issue: No functional issues found. Initial test flakes were purely test-harness timing (waiting for referrals API before asserting heading text; dismissing auto-opened Round-Result modal before clicking the daily bonus claim). Once those were handled the flow is deterministic and all UI + integration wiring works as specified.
